title: Dwelling Access Uplift on the Optional Coverage Add-Ons Haul-Away Limit
content:
An access uplift is added to the haul-away limit for equipment replaced under an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider, according to the dwelling type recorded on the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract:

| Dwelling recorded on the base homeowner contract | Access uplift |
|---|---|
| Condominium | USD 30.00 |
| Townhome | USD 20.00 |
| Any other dwelling type | None |

**Hypothetical cases.** A rider on a homeowner contract recorded as a condominium: USD 30.00 is added. A rider on a homeowner contract recorded as any other dwelling type: nothing is added.
